answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake behind one hardware-attested identity key before it can transact, like a falcon banded once and tracked for life. A Sybil farmer must buy a fresh device key and stake for every sockpuppet, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes plus hardware. Honest agents keep their stake and build a relic of verified history on the mesa of public attestations, while duplicate signing or spam slashes the stake and burns the key reputation.
